glossary.definition: The role accountable for decisions and review of a defined process.
An agreed statement of where mapped work starts and ends, identifying inputs received, outputs handed to another role, and decisions for which the owner is responsible.
The point at which a sender transfers an output to a receiving role, complete only when the receiver has what it needs to act.

recordNames: Current role assignments and actual handoffs
Date, evidence examined, disagreements found, and resolution owner
Accepted overview with scope and participants
